_comment: I-765 Helper's monthly spend ceiling and the copy shown when it is reached.
Copied from n400/budget.json on 2026-10-09 with the app name swapped and
nothing else: same -1 ceiling (no real user can reach this app until
com.weirtech.i765helper enters CZ_APPLE_BUNDLE_ID), same anonymous caps,
same device_test block (OFF). Read n400/budget.json for why each value
is what it is; every caveat there applies here word for word.
Per config/remote/OWNERSHIP.md, ADDING this file propagates on boot but
CHANGING a number does not: push through PUT /webhooks/admin/config/i765/budget.
_anonymous_comment: Anonymous I-765 installs: same three caps as N-400 (Scott's N-400 values,
lifetime, $50 across every anonymous install per UTC day. The route serves
these refusals with the i765_ prefix on `code` (anonymous_budget.wire_code).
